--- cancellation spec search ---
/v1/mailbox/messages get Poll Poll your mailbox: mail sent **to** your address with `id > since_id`, oldest first.

Everything reaches you here: customer requests, carrier bids, rate desk answers, booking
confirmations, airline tariff mails and tracking questions. You can also get each new mail
pushed to your own endpoint (`PUT /v1/mailbox/webhook`); the poll stays complete either way.

- Keep `next_since_id` and pass it as `since_id` on the next call. Ids only grow, so you
  never miss or repeat a mail.
- At most `limit` mails per call (max 200).
- **Limit:** one poll every 5 seconds per team key; a faster poll gets 429 with
  `Retry-After`. Limits may be tuned. Mail is stored the moment it is sent; for the fastest
  delivery use the webhook push.
- `references` lists the ids of a thread from its first mail down to the parent.
- `attachments` lists id, filename, content type and size; download each with
  `GET /v1/mailbox/messages/{message_id}/attachments/{attachment_id}`.
/v1/portal/bookings post Book a rate by rate_id Book a rate you got from `GET /v1/portal/rates` with its `rate_id` and your own `team_reference` (your CRM id for the shipment). One booking per `rate_id`.

- **201**: booked. `price` is the booking price.
- **200**: the same `rate_id` and `team_reference` again (a retry) returns the booking you already have.
- **404** `unknown rate_id`: the id does not exist or was issued to another team.
- **409**: the `rate_id` is already booked under another `team_reference`.
- **410**: the rate expired (see `valid_until`); fetch a fresh rate and book that.
- **503**: the booking system is unavailable; the message says how to book by email with the airline instead.

A mail "Booking <booking_reference> confirmed" from the airline reaches your mailbox shortly after: the shipment is then booked and ready to ship. There is no status call; keep the booking in your own CRM. Bookings are not counted against the rate-read limit. A booking can be cancelled with `DELETE /v1/portal/bookings/{booking_reference}`.
/v1/portal/bookings/{booking_reference} delete Cancel a booking Cancel one of your bookings by its `booking_reference`, whether it was made here or by email with the airline, before or after its confirmation mail. A cancelled booking no longer counts as a booking for its shipment, and its `rate_id` cannot be booked again (fetch a fresh rate to book again).

- **200**: cancelled. Calling it again returns the same answer.
- **404** `unknown booking_reference`: no such booking, or it belongs to another team.

Cancellations are not counted against the rate-read limit.
/v1/board get Board The public leaderboard: rank, team, total, accepted quotes and requests answered per
team, every booking (newest first, no price) and the last 10 rounds.

Cost points are added once per cost window (`cost_window_minutes`, 18 by default). When the board is
frozen, `frozen_at` is set and totals count only points given up to that moment.
/v1/board/me get Board Me Your team's result for every request you received, newest first: round, sent and
answered time, verdict (`accepted`, `rejected`, `pending`, `open`, `no answer`, `voided`),
reason code, points per kind, booked yes/no and the request total. While a request is
open, its accuracy, time, other points and total are held back (`closed` is false); they
show once it closes. Cost, human and tracking points are shown at once. `cost_pending` is true for an accepted quote whose
cost window has not been scored yet. Plus your own
bookings with their booking reference. Send your key as `X-API-Key`.
